span.p:
CTI Analysis Service
[Component: CTIanalysisToolbox]
High-level API for CTI analysis tasks.
Composes engine queries and returns
formatted results.
Methods: search_by_*, explain_*, get_*

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CTI Reasoning Engine
[Component: CTIEngine]
Core query execution and
reasoning logic. Constructs TypeQL queries,
applies inference rules, and
transforms database results.
Methods: get_techniques_used_by,
explain_*, filter_groups_*

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TypeDB Connector
[Component: TypeDBQueryHandler]
Manages database connections,
executes queries, handles sessions,
and retrieves inference explanations.
Methods: get_query, fetch_query,
aggregate_group_query

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
